questions.question: What are the vertical columns of the periodic table called?
questions.explanation: The vertical columns of the periodic table are called groups.

hi.question: आवर्त सारणी के उदग्र स्तम्भों को क्या कहा जाता है?

questions.question: How many covalent bonds are present in methane?

questions.question: Members of the first group of the periodic table are?
questions.explanation: Group 1 elements are called alkali metals.

questions.explanation: The modern periodic table is based on atomic number.

questions.question: What is the atomic number of iron?
